proposal.name: Tidal Ribbon
proposal.intent: A shaded outdoor gathering place beside the villa terrace.
proposal.character: A pale sweeping roof lifts and banks like a breaking wave.
proposal.details: Closed solid ribbon with four slender edge posts; existing villa materials. No glazing. Concept design only; drainage and engineering unresolved.
proposal.compatibility: Freestanding only. Entire rotated roof/post envelope must fit garden and clear buildings, pavilions, pools, courtyards, planting beds and circulation by .3m. Ordinary terrace paving allowed beneath posts.

candidate.originalIntent: Create a sculptural wave canopy beside the villa terrace; keep views open.
